Rounded wear and tiny folded corner peaks are approximated by straight cap/foot edges. Nitty Gritty Dirt Band three-record box, Pink Floyd double sleeve and Elton John sleeve retain their measured larger widths. Unreadable, heavily worn or partly overlapping seams use bounded estimates; all68 original catalog IDs are retained. The rightmost cream sleeve is inset from the angled exposed white interior wall.

method: Manual sleeve-edge anchor measurements on analysis crops from the original EXIF-oriented photos. Piecewise-linear sides, conservative2px inset. These are interactive central-face masks, not pixel-perfect sleeve segmentation. No original photo pixels are changed.
